sloka: तादृशम् वालिनः क्षिप्रम् प्राकुर्वन् और्ध्वदैहिकम् ।अंगदम् परिरभ्य आशु तार प्रभृतयः तथा ॥४-२५-३३॥
transliteration: tādṛśam vālinaḥ kṣipram prākurvan aurdhvadaihikam ।aṁgadam parirabhya āśu tāra prabhṛtayaḥ tathā ॥4-25-33॥

translations.english: Then all the female monkeys who were in his (Vali's) harem walked past the deadbody of Vali, crying again and again 'Alas, Oh hero'
